desc:
🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT! Dig up candy, beat the giant Pumpkin Boss and get the Pumpking, the best dog in the game! (until Nov 2) 🎃

🐶 Hatch, train and RACE your puppies in the cutest dog racing simulator! 🏁

🎃 PUMPKIN BOSS every 20 minutes: send your best dog and throw magic bones for big candy!
🍬 HALLOWEEN SHOP: trade candy for Halloween eggs, boosts and the Pumpking
🥚 HATCH eggs and collect 40+ dog breeds, up to shiny Mythic dogs!
🏁 RACE every 2 minutes for cash prizes, with hurdle races too!
🏋️ TRAIN your dogs at the Training Grounds to level them up.
🦴 DIG for bones to feed your dogs and make them stronger.
🏆 WIN the Dog Show, climb the leaderboards and win the weekly Cup!
💰 Your kennel keeps earning while you're offline. Rebirth for bigger prizes!

🎟️ CODES (Rewards ➜ Codes): WOOF, DIGGY, GOODBOY, ZOOMIES
👍 NEW CODE AT 50 LIKES! Like the game to unlock it, and ⭐ favorite so you don't miss it!
🔔 Join Blocksmith Games to get new codes and updates first!
